title: MMS Delivery Receipt Delays from a Subset of Twilio Short Codes to T-Mobile United States
impact_summary: MMS delivery receipt delays to T‑Mobile U.S. subscribers are being monitored after partial recovery.
backbase_rationale: Backbase only relies on Twilio for message delivery; the incident only affects delivery receipts, not message sending, so monitoring suffices.

title: IP Retrieval Failing for EU Regional Customers
impact_summary: We are continuing to investigate this issue.
backbase_rationale: There is not enough information to determine if this issue affects Backbase services, and immediate action is not required

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: Removal of the Send to Coworker action from domain authentication flow.
backbase_rationale: Because the Send to Coworker action is no longer available, Backbase must evaluate whether their integration uses it and adjust accordingly.

title: WhatsApp Card & Flows Support in Conversations (classic)
impact_summary: Conversations (classic) now supports WhatsApp Card and Flows content types
backbase_rationale: This change does not impact existing Backbase functionality, and new WhatsApp Card and Flows templates can be built and referenced using the Content Template Builder

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Sky United Kingdom
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from Twilio to Sky network subscribers in the United Kingdom.
backbase_rationale: Backbase action is required to ensure SMS delivery is not impacted to Sky customers.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication
impact_summary: Twilio SendGrid removed the Send to Coworker action from Domain Authentication setup flow due to low usage.
backbase_rationale: Backbase needs to assess if they use the Send to Coworker action and determine alternative methods to manage DNS records within their digital banking platform.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Sky UK
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from Twilio to Sky network subscribers in the United Kingdom.
backbase_rationale: No immediate action required as Twilio team is working to resolve the issue.

title: SendGrid product switcher signup unavailable
impact_summary: Customers may experience inability to complete the product switcher signup flow.
backbase_rationale: No Backbase action is required as the issue is specific to SendGrid and not affecting Backbase directly.

title: SMS Delivery Failures from a Subset of Twilio Long Codes to DiGi Malaysia
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery failures from a subset of Twilio Long Codes to DiGi network subscribers in Malaysia
backbase_rationale: No immediate action is required as this incident only impacts Twilio customers, not Backbase

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Multiple Networks in Colombia
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from Twilio to network subscribers on multiple networks in Colombia.
backbase_rationale: Backbase may need to implement failover routing to ensure customer experience is maintained.

title: SMS Delivery Receipt Delays from a Subset of Twilio Short Codes to T-Mobile United States
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing MMS delivery receipt delays from a subset of Twilio Short Codes to T-Mobile network subscribers in the United States.
backbase_rationale: Backbase should continue to monitor this issue and assess whether it will impact customer experience.

title: WhatsApp Card & Flows Support in Conversations (classic) is likely to require new feature implementation and testing to handle new WhatsApp Card templates and WhatsApp Flow templates
impact_summary: WhatsApp Card templates and WhatsApp Flow templates are now supported directly through the Conversations API, enabling new capabilities for interactive, multi-step WhatsApp Flows.
backbase_rationale: Backbase should implement and test the necessary feature to support new WhatsApp Card templates and WhatsApp Flow templates in its integration with Twilio Conversations.
